name: zone_power_loss
description: A transformer or feeder trips and every post under it goes dark at once
seed_discipline: run under a fixed seed; cite the run ID
mechanism: public.ottoq_twin_trip_power_node(sim_run_id, node_code, repair_minutes, actor) (db/migrations/0810): every post under the node in ottoq_power_nodes faults through ottoq_twin_inject_charger_fault, one post at a time; the trip is recorded once in ottoq_power_node_trips as a common-cause event. From the cockpit: otto-twin-control POST inject_fault {kind: power_zone, target_id: <node_code>, payload: {repair_minutes}}. The site-wide cap (inject_dr_call {cap_kw, duration_min}) is still a separate injector
nodes: the twin depot's one-line: TX-A1, TX-A2, TX-B1, TX-B2, TX-C1, TX-C2 (five posts each), MV-SWGR and SERVICE (all thirty)
expected_kernel_behavior: each open session on the node's posts ends faulted and its car is re-queued to finish its charge on a post under another transformer (rule 9: a charger fault ends a charge short, and the car is re-queued); the posts read Faulted until repair_minutes have passed on the sim clock, then return to service together
measured: db/checks/0481: lab, busy_day seed 171717, TX-A1 tripped for 90 sim-min with two cars charging at 96% and 93%; both finished at 100% on posts under TX-A2 and TX-C2; production run 54c0d20f (2026-11-11): TX-B1 tripped with four cars charging, db/checks/0482
